assertions.description: PerformanceResourceTiming exposes encodedBodySize, decodedBodySize and transferSize.
assertions.test: 'encodedBodySize' in PerformanceResourceTiming.prototype && 'decodedBodySize' in PerformanceResourceTiming.prototype && 'transferSize' in PerformanceResourceTiming.prototype

assertions.description: A same-origin fetch always exposes non-zero encoded and decoded body sizes for a non-empty response — no gate applies.
assertions.test: (async () => { const url = '/public/styles.css?conf-rt=' + Date.now(); const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' }); await res.blob(); const t0 = performance.now(); let e = null; while (performance.now() - t0 < 2500) { e = performance.getEntriesByName(new URL(url, location.href).href).filter((x) => x.entryType === 'resource').at(-1) ?? null; if (e) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60)); } return !!e && e.decodedBodySize > 0 && e.encodedBodySize > 0 && e.transferSize > 0; })()

assertions.description: A cross-origin resource fetched with CORS (ACAO present, no Timing-Allow-Origin) exposes encoded/decoded body sizes — the new CORS gate. Requires network access to raw.githubusercontent.com; a fetch error fails with its detail.
assertions.test: (async () => { const url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w3c/resource-timing/gh-pages/README.md?conf-rt=' + Date.now(); const res = await fetch(url, { mode: 'cors', cache: 'no-store' }); await res.blob(); const t0 = performance.now(); let e = null; while (performance.now() - t0 < 2500) { e = performance.getEntriesByName(url).filter((x) => x.entryType === 'resource').at(-1) ?? null; if (e) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60)); } if (!e) throw new Error('no resource timing entry'); return e.decodedBodySize > 0 && e.encodedBodySize > 0; })()

assertions.description: An opaque (no-cors) response no longer exposes body sizes even when it carries Timing-Allow-Origin: * — TAO alone stops being the body-size gate. Requires network access to cdn.jsdelivr.net.
assertions.test: (async () => { const url = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/preact@10.19.3/dist/preact.min.js?conf-rt=' + Date.now(); const res = await fetch(url, { mode: 'no-cors', cache: 'no-store' }); try { await res.blob(); } catch {} const t0 = performance.now(); let e = null; while (performance.now() - t0 < 2500) { e = performance.getEntriesByName(url).filter((x) => x.entryType === 'resource').at(-1) ?? null; if (e) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60)); } if (!e) throw new Error('no resource timing entry'); return e.decodedBodySize === 0 && e.encodedBodySize === 0 && e.transferSize === 0; })()

assertions.description: transferSize stays 0 for a CORS response without Timing-Allow-Origin — under the new rules it requires both opt-ins. Requires network access to raw.githubusercontent.com.
assertions.test: (async () => { const url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w3c/resource-timing/gh-pages/README.md?conf-rt2=' + Date.now(); const res = await fetch(url, { mode: 'cors', cache: 'no-store' }); await res.blob(); const t0 = performance.now(); let e = null; while (performance.now() - t0 < 2500) { e = performance.getEntriesByName(url).filter((x) => x.entryType === 'resource').at(-1) ?? null; if (e) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60)); } if (!e) throw new Error('no resource timing entry'); return e.decodedBodySize > 0 && e.transferSize === 0; })()

assertions.description: responseStatus, the precedent CORS-gated attribute this change aligns with, is exposed for a CORS response regardless of TAO. Requires network access to raw.githubusercontent.com.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (!('responseStatus' in PerformanceResourceTiming.prototype)) return false; const url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w3c/resource-timing/gh-pages/README.md?conf-rt3=' + Date.now(); const res = await fetch(url, { mode: 'cors', cache: 'no-store' }); await res.blob(); const t0 = performance.now(); let e = null; while (performance.now() - t0 < 2500) { e = performance.getEntriesByName(url).filter((x) => x.entryType === 'resource').at(-1) ?? null; if (e) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60)); } if (!e) throw new Error('no resource timing entry'); return e.responseStatus === 200; })()
